newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Papers cites lower demand for Q4 drop.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Papers cites lower demand for Q4 drop.

text.p: Consolidated Papers Inc said Monday weaker demand and lower prices for certain products reduced its sales and profits in the fourth quarter.

The company reported sales of $364 million in the quarter ended December 31, compared to sales of $452.6 million one year ago. Net income in the latest period reached $37.2 million, versus $73.1 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Company officials said future performance improvements will depend on growth in demand and improved selling prices.
Consolidated Papers makes a variety of coated paper goods used in the publishing industry. Its shares were trading unchanged Monday at 50-1/2.
